arStrings.szText: {c_important}Blade Shift's{/c} shift now lasts for {c_number}{SF_24}{/c} additional seconds and while active, grants you {c_number}[{SF_8}*100|%x|]{/c} increased Movement Speed. When you move through an enemy, {c_important}Blade Shift{/c} is empowered to deal {c_number}[SF_21*100|%x|]{/c} increased damage while active.

{c_important}Blade Shift{/c} now deals {c_number}{payload:UPGRADEB_IMPACT}{/c} damage and while {c_important}{u}Unhindered{/u}{/c} by {c_important}Blade Shift{/c}, you drop {c_number}{SF_26}{/c} {c_important}{u}Stun Grenades{/u}{/c} that each deal {c_number}{payload:UPGRADEB_GRENADES_TOOLTIP}{/c} damage on the enemies you pass through.

{c_important}Blade Shift{/c} now deals {c_number}{payload:UPGRADEC_IMPACT}{/c} Shadow damage and moving through an enemy while {c_important}{u}Unhindered{/u}{/c} by {c_important}Blade Shift{/c} automatically attacks that enemy with {c_important}Blade Shift{/c}.
While {c_important}Blade Shift{/c} is active, gain {c_number}+{SF_31}{/c} and {c_number}[{SF_29} * 100|1x%|]{/c} Resistance to All Elements.
When you move through an enemy, gain {c_number}{SF_32}{/c} Energy.
When you move through an enemy, gain {c_number}{SF_34}{/c} stack of {c_important}{u}Overpower{/u}{/c}.
When you move through an enemy, gain {c_number}{SF_34}{/c} stack of {c_important}{u}Resolve{/u}{/c}.
